FORMOSAN ASSOCIATION TO BE INAUGURATED

It is reported that on the
proposal of Chief Inspector Naito of the Japanese
Consular Police, Mr. Iwata of the Fukutai Company, and
Mr. Takagi, manager of the Taiwan Fruit Shop, a Formosan
Association will be inaugurated at 5 p.m. to-day at the
Japanese Club. The object of the Association is to
bring about co-operation among Formosans in Central China.

拟成立台湾人协会

据报，在日本领事馆警察首席督察内藤（Naito）的提议下，福泰公司（Fukutai Company）的岩田（Iwata）先生以及台湾水果店经理高木（Takagi）先生发起，将于今日下午5时在日本俱乐部举行台湾人协会成立仪式。该协会的宗旨是促进华中地区台湾人之间的合作。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. MUNICIPAL
S. B. REG. 8528
S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date 20, 1938.

Subject Inauguration of the Taiwan Club in Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Kamashita Forwarded by C. Crawford

With reference to the attached translation from the
"Shanghai Nippo" dated May 18, 1938, regarding the inauguration
of the Formosan Association, I have to state that some time
ago Chief Inspector Naito of the Japanese Consular Police,
Mr. Iwata, manager of the Fukutai Company, and Mr. Takagi,
manager of the Taiwan Fruit Shop, all persons who have had
connections with Formosa at one time or another, proposed
the formation of a Formosan Association with the object of
promoting friendship among natives of Formosa and persons who
had resided there. A meeting was called on May 18th at
5 p.m. in the Japanese Club, Boone Road, and was attended
by some 60 persons. Among those who attended the gathering
were Major Hayashi, Chief of the Political Section of the
Japanese Gendarmerie in Shanghai, Chief Inspector Naito,
Mr. Iwata, Mr. Takagi, Mr. Chiu Cho Fuku (陳維福), former
President of the Formosan Residents Association in Amoy,
and Mr. Shu Shaku-ki (周錫喜), former President of the
Formosan Residents Association in Foochow.

During the meeting it was agreed that an association to
be known as the "Taiwan Club" be promoted and Messrs. Ando,
Iwata, and Shironouchi were selected to form the presidium
of the Club. A dinner was later given in honour of the
occasion.

D.C. (Special Branch)

D. S. Kamashita

档案号：市政
S. B. REG. 8528
S.1，特别科。
报告
日期：1938年20日。

主题：上海台湾俱乐部成立事宜。

呈报人：D.S. Kamashita 转呈人：C. Crawford

关于附上的1938年5月18日《上海日报》有关台湾人协会成立的译文，本人谨陈述如下：此前，日本领事馆警察首席督察内藤、福泰公司经理岩田先生以及台湾水果店经理高木先生——这些人均曾与台湾有过某种联系——提议成立一个台湾人协会，旨在促进台湾本地人及曾在台居住者之间的友谊。会议于5月18日下午5时在布恩路（Boone Road）的日本俱乐部召开，约有60人出席。出席此次聚会的人员包括：上海日本宪兵队政治科科长林（Hayashi）少佐、首席督察内藤、岩田先生、高木先生、前厦门台湾居民协会会长陈维福（Chiu Cho Fuku）先生，以及前福州台湾居民协会会长周锡喜（Shu Shaku-ki）先生。

会议期间，各方同意推动成立一个名为“台湾俱乐部”的协会，并推选安藤（Ando）、岩田和白之内（Shironouchi）三位先生组成俱乐部主席团。随后举行了晚宴以资庆祝。

特别科侦探警长（D.C.）

D. S. Kamashita
